mapper.sql: id, product_id, seckill_price, stock, limit_per_user, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM seckill WHERE status = 1 AND start_time > #{now} AND start_time <= DATE_ADD(#{now}, INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) ORDER BY start_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seckill (id, product_id, seckill_price, stock, limit_per_user, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{productId}, #{seckillPrice}, #{stock}, #{limitPerUser}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE seckill SET status = 0 WHERE status = 1 AND end_time < #{now}
